segments.pv47:1.1: “Ayañca te pokkharaṇī surammā, samā sutitthā ca mahodakā ca;
segments.pv47:1.3: Supupphitā bhamaragaṇānukiṇṇā, kathaṃ tayā laddhā ayaṃ manuññā.
segments.pv47:2.1: “Idañca te ambavanaṃ surammaṃ, sabbotukaṃ dhārayate [dhārayati (syā. ka.)] phalāni;
segments.pv47:2.3: Supupphitaṃ bhamaragaṇānukiṇṇaṃ, kathaṃ tayā laddhamidaṃ vimānaṃ”.
segments.pv47:3.1: “Ambapakkaṃ dakaṃ [ambapakkodakaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), ambapakkūdakaṃ (ka.)] yāgu, sītacchāyā manoramā;
segments.pv47:3.3: Dhītāya dinnadānena, tena me idha labbhati”.
segments.pv47:4.1: “Sandiṭṭhikaṃ kammaṃ evaṃ [sandiṭṭhikaṃ eva (syā.)] passatha, dānassa damassa saṃyamassa vipākaṃ;
segments.pv47:4.3: Dāsī ahaṃ ayyakulesu hutvā, suṇisā homi agārassa issarā”ti.

lines: Taṃ sutvā peto pokkharaṇiādīnaṃ paṭilābhakāraṇaṃ ācikkhanto –
Dhītāya dinnadānena, tena me idha labbhatī”ti.

Tattha tena me idha labbhatīti yaṃ taṃ bhagavato bhikkhūnañca ambapakkaṃ udakaṃ yāguñca mamaṃ uddissa dentiyā mayhaṃ dhītāya dinnaṃ dānaṃ, tena me dhītāya dinnadānena idha imasmiṃ dibbe ambavane sabbotukaṃ ambapakkaṃ, imissā dibbāya manuññāya pokkharaṇiyā dibbaṃ udakaṃ, yāguyā attharaṇassa ca dānena uyyānavimānakapparukkhādīsu sītacchāyā manoramā idha labbhati, samijjhatīti attho.
